note: Saint Martin keeps the overseas departments' list, except that Venezuelans need a visa; Dominicans and Saint Lucians stay 15 days a stay (no more than 120 in 12 months, not modelled). Travellers coming directly from Sint Maarten cross the open border (not modelled). Légifrance answers this client with a bot challenge, so the orders are read from Wikipedia's copy.
